/-- `g₂(t)` [H, Lemma 5.1.2]. -/
noncomputable def g2 (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r₁ ∈ Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, ∑ r₂ ∈ Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊,
    if Nat.Coprime r₁ r₂ ∧ Odd (r₁ * r₂) then
      (μ r₁ : ℝ) * μ r₂ / ((σ 1 r₁ : ℝ) * σ 1 r₂) else 0

proof_context.conclusion: `g2 t` is $g_2(t)$: the sum over $r_1,r_2\le\lfloor t\rfloor$, coprime with $r_1r_2$ odd, of $\mu(r_1)\mu(r_2)/(\sigma(r_1)\sigma(r_2))$; this is $g_v$ for $v=2$ only.

theorem abs_Nodd_sub_le {S y : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hyS : y ≤ S) : |Nodd S y - S / (4 * y)| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [Nodd_eq hy hyS]

  have h := abs_card_odd_sub_le (α := S / (2 * y)) (by positivity)
  have e : S / (2 * y) / 2 = S / (4 * y) := by ring
  rwa [e] at h

/-- The triple sum `T₂(S) = ∑_{s ≤ S odd} (1/s) ∫_{1/2}^1 g₂(uS/s) du` [H, (5.28)]. -/
noncomputable def T2 (S : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s ∈ Icc 1 ⌊S⌋₊, if Odd s then (1 / s : ℝ) * ∫ u in (1 / 2 : ℝ)..1, g2 (u * S / s) else 0

proof_context.conclusion: `T2 S` $=\sum_{s\le S,\ s\ odd}\frac1s\int_{1/2}^1 g_2(uS/s)\,du$, the triple sum of [H, (5.28)] for $v=2$.

ends.snippet:
/-- **`T₂(S) = a(n) − a(⌊n/2⌋)/2 + (c(n) − c(⌊n/2⌋))/S`** for `S ∈ [n, n+1)`. -/
theorem T2_eq_ac {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {S : ℝ} (h1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ S) (h2 : S < n + 1) :
    T2 S = areal n - areal (n / 2) / 2 + (creal n - creal (n / 2)) / S := by

proof_context.conclusion: For $S\in[n,n+1)$, $n\ge1$: `T2 S = areal n - areal (n/2)/2 + (creal n - creal (n/2))/S`, i.e. $T_2(S)=\alpha_n+\beta_n/S$ exactly with $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ depending only on $\lfloor S\rfloor$.
